summary: Wiring the new validator selftest into .github/workflows/audit-bindings.yml - beside its sibling check-audit-bindings.py --selftest, the obviously right place - made feedback/2026-08-02-Rogue3-7 and -9 fail validate, because both audits cite that workflow file. The item's own acceptance target was destroyed by a five-line CI edit. Moved the step to .github/workflows/verify.yml, which no audit cites, and both reports returned to green. Any file an accepted audit cites is effectively frozen: the gate can excuse an edit to it via the ledger, but the validator has no ledger, so the only validator remedy is rebinding merged evidence, which 7e71d71 forbids.
